```{r meta analysis}
### META-ANALYSIS ###
### PURCHASE PROBABILITY + WTP

# ### FIXED EFFECTS ###
# meta_model1 <- rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "FE", mods = ~ information+label+loan+rebate+subsidy+0)
# summary(meta_model1)
# # fixed effects by intervention
# 
# meta_model2 <- rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "FE", mods = ~ appliance+0)
# summary(meta_model2)
# # fixed effects by appliance

# ### RANDOM EFFECTS ###
# meta_model3 <- rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "REML", mods = ~ information+label+loan+rebate+subsidy+0)
# summary(meta_model3)
# # random effects by intervention
# 
# meta_model4 <- rma(z_value, z_variance, data = data_purchase, method = "REML", mods = ~ appliance+0)
# summary(meta_model4)
# # random effects by appliance

### MULTI-LEVEL MODEL ###
meta_model0 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, 
                            random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model0, digits = 2)

meta_model5 <- rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ information+label+loan+rebate+subsidy+0,
                             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model5, digits = 2)
# random effects multi-level by intervention

meta_model6 <- rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ appliance+0,
                             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model6, digits = 2)
# random effects by appliance

### INTERACTION INTERVENTION X APPLIANCE ###
data_purchase1 <- data_purchase %>%
  filter(appliance %in% c("Refrigerator", "Lighting", "Water Heater", "Air-Conditioner"))

meta_model7 <- rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ intervention_category:appliance+0, 
                             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase1, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model7, digits = 2)
# random effects multi-level interaction between intervention category and appliance
```


```{r forest plot, eval=FALSE}
### AVERAGE EFFECT PLOT ### 
coef_summary5 <- coef(summary(meta_model5))
rownames(coef_summary5) <- c("Information \n(n = 53)","Label \n(n = 126)","Loan \n(n = 12)","Rebate \n(n = 31)","Subsidy \n(n = 27)")
average_estimate5 <- mean(coef_summary5$estimate)
ggplot(coef_summary5,
       aes(x = row.names(coef_summary5), y = estimate)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = ci.lb, ymax = ci.ub),
                 size = 1.5, alpha = 1, colour = "red")  +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", size = .5)+
  annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = average_estimate5 - 0.025, label = paste("Average:", round(average_estimate5, 2)), size = 4.5) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.15, 0.35)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "z-value") +
  ylim(-.5, 0.5)+

  theme(text = element_text(size = 20))
ggsave("revisedinterventions_forest_5.png")
```

```{r assess publication bias}
### PUBLICATION BIAS ASSESSMENT ###
library(lmtest)

### EGGERS TEST ### 
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
# Define a color palette with enough colors for each unique appliance
palette <- brewer.pal(length(unique(data_purchase$appliance)),"Set1")
appliance_colors <- setNames(palette, unique(data_purchase$appliance))

### FUNNEL PLOT ###
funnel(
  data_purchase$z_value, 
  v = data_purchase$z_variance,
  # ylim = c(0, 0.3),
  col = appliance_colors[as.factor(data_purchase$appliance)], 
  legend = FALSE # We'll create the legend manually
)

# # causes error - you need to run the plot and the legend at the same time rather than consecutively
# Create the legend manually using the legend() function
legend("topright", # Position of the legend
       legend = levels(as.factor(data_purchase$appliance)), # Legend labels
       col = appliance_colors,
       pch = 15, # Point type (change if needed)
       title = "Appliance", # Legend title (change if needed)
       cex = 0.8
)

# Count occurrences of each intervention
intervention_counts <- data_purchase %>%
  group_by(intervention) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

palette <- brewer.pal(length(unique(data_purchase$intervention_category)),"Set1")
intervention_colors <- setNames(palette, unique(data_purchase$intervention_category))

#palette <- brewer.pal(length(unique(intervention_counts$intervention)),"Set1")
#intervention_colors <- setNames(palette, intervention_counts$intervention)

funnel(
  data_purchase$z_value, 
  v = data_purchase$z_variance,
  ylim = c(0, 0.3),
  col = intervention_colors[as.factor(data_purchase$intervention_category)], 
  legend = FALSE # We'll create the legend manually
)

# Create the legend manually using the legend() function
legend("topright", # Position of the legend
       legend = levels(as.factor(data_purchase$intervention_category)), # Legend labels
        col = intervention_colors, # Legend colors
        pch = 15, # Point type (change if needed)
       title = "Intervention", # Legend title (change if needed)
        cex = 0.8
       )

data_purchase$se = (data_purchase$z_variance)^(1/2)

# Model without publication bias correction
meta_model0 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, 
                            random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model0, digits = 2)

# Egger's test
meta_egger <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ se, 
                           random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_egger, digits = 2)

meta_egger1 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+ information+label+loan+rebate+subsidy+se,
                            random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_egger1, digits = 2)

meta_egger2_2 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~ 0+appliance+se,
                              random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_egger2_2, digits = 2)


# bias correction

meta_model0_1 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~z_variance , 
                             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model0_1, digits = 2)

meta_model5_1 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~  information+label+loan+rebate+subsidy+0+z_variance,
                              random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model5_1, digits = 2)

meta_model6_1 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods = ~ appliance+0+z_variance,
                       random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase, method = "REML")
summary(meta_model6_1, digits = 2)


```

```{r identify outliers}
# these thresholds are identified by looking at the graphs and identifying the peaks

# intervention model
x5 <- cooks.distance(meta_model5)

threshold <- .2
plot(x5, type="l", pch=19, xlab="Observed Outcome", ylab="Cook's Distance")
for (i in 1:length(x5)) {
  if (x5[i] > threshold) {
    text(i, x5[i], i, cex = 1, pos = 4, col = "red")
  }
}

below_threshold_rows5 <- which(x5 < threshold ) #| data_purchase$intervention == "Loan"
data_purchase5 <- data_purchase[below_threshold_rows5 ,]

plot(x5, type="o", pch=19, xlab="Observed Outcome", ylab="Cook's Distance")
text(x5,labels=names(x5))

above_threshold_rows5 <- which(x5 > threshold)
outlier_cooksd5 <- data_purchase[above_threshold_rows5,]

# # appliance model
x6 <- cooks.distance(meta_model6)

threshold <- .2
plot(x6, type="l", pch=19, xlab="Observed Outcome", ylab="Cook's Distance")
for (i in 1:length(x6)) {
  if (x6[i] > threshold) {
    text(i, x6[i], i, cex = 1, pos = 4, col = "red")
  }
}

below_threshold_rows6 <- which(x6 < threshold)
data_purchase6 <- data_purchase[below_threshold_rows6,]

plot(x6, type="o", pch=19, xlab="Observed Outcome", ylab="Cook's Distance")
text(x6,labels=names(x6))

above_threshold_rows6 <- which(x6 > threshold)
outlier_cooksd6 <- data_purchase[above_threshold_rows6,]


```

```{r sensitivity check for R&R}

# meta_model5_3 <-rma.mv(z_value, z_variance, mods =  ~z_variance + study_design,
#                             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID), data = data_purchase2, method = "REML")
# summary(meta_model5_3, digits = 2)

# Make sure study_design is a factor
# data_purchase2$study_design <- factor(
#   data_purchase2$study_design,
#   levels = c("control_&_treatment", 
#              "DID", 
#              "pre_and_post", 
#              "quasi-experimental", 
#              "simulated_counterfactual")
# )

study_designs <- levels(data_purchase2$study_design)

results <- list()

for (design in study_designs) {
  cat("\nProcessing study_design =", design, "\n")
  
  subset_data <- droplevels(subset(data_purchase2, study_design == design))
  
  if (nrow(subset_data) > 1) {
    meta_model <- tryCatch({
      rma.mv(z_value, z_variance,
             # mods = ~ z_variance,
             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID),
             data = subset_data,
             method = "REML")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error for", design, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(meta_model)) {
      # Extract coefficient table
      coef_table <- coef(summary(meta_model, digits = 2))
      coef_df <- data.frame(
        study_design = design,
        k            = summary(meta_model)$k,
        estimate     = coef_table[, "estimate"],
        se           = coef_table[, "se"],
        zval         = coef_table[, "zval"],
        pval         = coef_table[, "pval"],
        ci.lb        = coef_table[, "ci.lb"],
        ci.ub        = coef_table[, "ci.ub"]
      )
      results[[design]] <- coef_df
    }
  }
}

# Combine all results into one tidy table
final_results <- bind_rows(results)


# Round numeric columns to 2 decimals
final_results <- final_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

print(final_results)
write.table(final_results,"Study_designsensitivity.csv")



```


```{r sensitivity check for R&R}

# Fit the overall model including reportingBiases
bias_levels <- levels(data_purchase2$reportingBiases)

results <- list()

for (bias in bias_levels) {
  cat("\nProcessing reportingBiases =", bias, "\n")
  
  subset_data <- droplevels(subset(data_purchase2, reportingBiases == bias))
  
  if (nrow(subset_data) > 1) {
    meta_model <- tryCatch({
      rma.mv(z_value, z_variance,
             # mods = ~ z_variance,
             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID),
             data = subset_data,
             method = "REML")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error for", bias, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(meta_model)) {
      # Extract coefficient table
      coef_table <- coef(summary(meta_model, digits = 2))
      coef_df <- data.frame(
        reportingBiases = bias,
        k               = summary(meta_model)$k,
        estimate        = coef_table[, "estimate"],
        se              = coef_table[, "se"],
        zval            = coef_table[, "zval"],
        pval            = coef_table[, "pval"],
        ci.lb           = coef_table[, "ci.lb"],
        ci.ub           = coef_table[, "ci.ub"]
      )
      results[[bias]] <- coef_df
    }
  }
}

# Combine all results into one tidy table
final_results <- bind_rows(results)

# Round numeric columns to 2 decimals
final_results <- final_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

print(final_results)
write.table(final_results, "ReportingBiasesSensitivity.csv")

```


```{r sensitivity check for R&R}

# Fit the overall model including incentivefollowthrough
incentive_levels <- levels(data_purchase2$incentive_follow_through)

results <- list()

for (incentive in incentive_levels) {
  cat("\nProcessing incentivefollowthrough =", incentive, "\n")
  
  subset_data <- droplevels(subset(data_purchase2, incentive_follow_through == incentive))
  
  if (nrow(subset_data) > 1) {
    meta_model <- tryCatch({
      rma.mv(z_value, z_variance,
             # mods = ~ z_variance,
             random = ~ as.factor(sr_no) | as.factor(study_ID),
             data = subset_data,
             method = "REML")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error for", incentive, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(meta_model)) {
      # Extract coefficient table
      coef_table <- coef(summary(meta_model, digits = 2))
      coef_df <- data.frame(
        incentive_follow_through = incentive,
        k               = summary(meta_model)$k,
        estimate        = coef_table[, "estimate"],
        se              = coef_table[, "se"],
        zval            = coef_table[, "zval"],
        pval            = coef_table[, "pval"],
        ci.lb           = coef_table[, "ci.lb"],
        ci.ub           = coef_table[, "ci.ub"]
      )
      results[[incentive]] <- coef_df
    }
  }
}

# Combine all results into one tidy table
final_results <- bind_rows(results)

# Round numeric columns to 2 decimals
final_results <- final_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

print(final_results)
write.table(final_results, "IncentiveFollowthroughSensitivity.csv")

```

```{r prepare for BMA}
controlvars <- c(

  "incentive_follow_through",
  "experimental_setting",
  "participant_type",

  "opt_in",
  "randomisation_dummy",
  "outOfSampleBias",
  "reportingBiases",
  "controls_energy_prices",
  "controls_environmental_attitudes",
  "controls_demographics"
  )

metregvar <- c("z_value", "z_variance")
dfbms <- data_purchase  %>% select(all_of(metregvar))
dfbms <- ungroup(dfbms)
dfbms <- dfbms %>% select(-c(study_ID))
# dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.character, as.numeric)
# dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.logical, as.numeric)
```

```{r prepare for BMA}
# BMA data preparation 
# create binary variables for all control factor variables

# iterate over each factor variable
for (var_name in controlvars) {
  
  # get unique factor levels
  
  levels <- unique(data_purchase[[var_name]])
  
  # create binary variables for each factor level
  for (level in levels[-1]) {
    # create a new column name by appending the factor level to the variable name
    new_col_name <- paste(var_name, level, sep = "_")
    
    # create a binary variable for the current factor level
    dfbms[[new_col_name]] <- as.numeric(data_purchase[[var_name]] == level)
  }
}

names(dfbms) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(dfbms))
dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.character, as.numeric)
dfbms <- mutate_if(dfbms, is.logical, as.numeric)
summary(dfbms)
```

```{r ! run BMA}
percent = bms(dfbms, burn=1e5,iter=3e5, g="UIP", mprior="uniform", nmodel=50000, mcmc="bd", user.int=FALSE)
percent1 = bms(dfbms, burn=1e5,iter=3e5, g="UIP", mprior="dilut", nmodel=50000, mcmc="bd", user.int=FALSE)
percent2 = bms(dfbms, burn=1e5,iter=3e5, g="BRIC", mprior="random", nmodel=50000, mcmc="bd", user.int=FALSE)

coef <- as.data.frame(coef(percent, order.by.pip = T, exact=T, yprop2pip=T, include.constant=T))

# image(percent, yprop2pip=FALSE, order.by.pip=T, do.par=TRUE, do.grid=TRUE, do.axis=TRUE, cex.axis = 0.7)
# summary(percent)

coef1 <- as.data.frame(coef(percent1, order.by.pip = F, exact=T, include.constant=T))
coef2 <- as.data.frame(coef(percent2, order.by.pip = F, exact=T, include.constant=T))
coeff <- cbind(coef, coef1, coef2)
print(coeff)
write.table(coeff,"BMA_estimates.csv")
```

```{r}
                                     if(is.numeric(x)) round(x, 2) else x))
```
